descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_minSize@: It takes a minimum size and an optional error message or options, and returns a validation check requiring a sized collection to contain at least that many elements.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_maxLengt: It takes a maximum length and optional settings or an error message, and returns a validation check that values with a length don't exceed that maximum.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_multiple: This function takes a numeric divisor (regular or big integer) and optional settings or an error message, and returns a validation check that a value is an exact multiple of it.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_length@9: This function takes a required exact length plus an optional error message or options object, and returns a validation check that only passes for values of exactly that length.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_uppercas: It takes an optional error message or configuration options and returns a new string validation check that requires the text to be entirely uppercase.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_negative: It takes an optional error message or configuration options and returns a validation check requiring a numeric value to be strictly less than zero, meaning negative.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_minLengt: It takes a minimum length and optional error message or settings, and returns a validation check requiring any value with a length to be at least that long.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_lowercas: It takes an optional error message or settings object and returns a new string validation check that requires the text to be entirely lowercase.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_regex@94: It takes a regular expression and an optional error message or settings, and returns a string validation check that requires input to match that pattern.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_includes: It takes a required substring and optional settings or an error message, and returns a string validation check confirming that a value contains that substring.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_overwrit: It takes a function that turns a value into a new value of the same type, and returns a validation check that replaces the input with that function's result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_mime@101: Takes a list of allowed media types and optional settings or an error message, and returns a validation check that verifies a file's media type is among them.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_property: It takes a property name, a validation schema, and optional parameters or a message, and returns a check that validates that the named property satisfies the schema.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_endsWith: This function takes a required suffix string and optional configuration or error message, and returns a validation check object confirming that a string ends with that suffix.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_normaliz: It takes an optional Unicode normalization form and returns a validation check that overwrites a string with its Unicode-normalized version in that form.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_trim@103: It takes no arguments and returns a validation check that replaces a string value with a copy stripped of leading and trailing whitespace.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_toUpperC: This function takes no arguments and returns a validation check that transforms any string input into its uppercase form, replacing the original value.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_union@10: It takes a schema class constructor, a list of object schemas, and optional parameters or an error message, and returns a new union schema accepting any of those options.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_startsWi: It takes a required prefix string and optional settings or an error message, and returns a validation check confirming that a string begins with that prefix.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_toLowerC: This function takes no arguments and returns a validation check that transforms an input string by replacing it with its lowercase version.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_intersec: Given a schema constructor and two object schemas, it builds and returns a new intersection schema combining them, so validated data must satisfy both the left and right schemas.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_array@10: It takes a schema class, an element schema and optional parameters or an error message, and returns a new array schema validating lists of that element type.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_tuple@11: Given a tuple schema class, a non-empty list of element schemas, and optional settings or an error message, it returns a fixed-length tuple schema with no rest element.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_record@1: This factory takes a schema class, a key schema, a value schema, and optional settings or an error message, and returns a new record-type validation schema built from them.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_map@1175: This takes a map schema class, key and value schemas, and optional parameters or an error message, and returns a new map schema that validates keys and values against them.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_tuple@11: Given a schema class constructor, a non-empty list of element schemas, a schema for any additional trailing elements, and optional error message or settings, it returns a typed tuple-validation schema.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_discrimi: It takes a schema class, a discriminator key name, a non-empty list of candidate schemas, and optional parameters or an error message, and returns a newly constructed discriminated-union schema.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_tuple@11: It takes a tuple schema class, a list of element schemas, an optional trailing "rest" schema and optional parameters, and returns a new tuple schema instance.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_enum@121: It takes a schema class, a list or key-value object of allowed values, and optional settings, and returns a new enumeration validation schema built from them.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_set@1191: It takes a set schema class, an object schema for the elements, and optional parameters or an error message, and returns a new set schema validating collections of those elements.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_enum@121: It takes a schema class, an enum-like object of allowed values, and an optional error message or configuration, and returns an enum validation schema restricted to those values.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_enum@120: This function takes a schema class, a list of literal strings, and optional settings or an error message, and returns a schema that accepts only those string values.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_nativeEn: It takes a schema class, an enum-like object of allowed values, and optional settings or an error message, and returns a new enum validation schema built from them.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_literal@: It takes a schema class, a single literal value, and optional parameters or an error message string, and returns a schema that validates only that exact literal value.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_file@127: It takes a schema class constructor and optional parameters (a message string or options object) and returns a new file-validation schema instance built with the normalized parameters.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_literal@: This function takes a literal schema class, an array of allowed literal values, and optional settings or an error message, and returns a schema matching any of those values.
This function takes a schema class, one or more allowed values, and optional parameters, and returns a new literal-type schema instance that accepts only those values, with the parameters normalized.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_transfor: It takes a schema class constructor and a conversion function, and returns a new transformation schema that applies that function to input values, producing awaited output values.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_nullable: It takes a nullable-schema constructor and an object schema, and returns a new schema wrapping that object so it also accepts null.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_optional: Given a schema class constructor and an object schema, it builds and returns a new schema that wraps the original, allowing values to be optionally absent.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_catch@13: <send_message>It takes a schema class, an inner object schema, and a fallback value or fallback-producing function, and returns a new schema that yields that fallback whenever validation of the inner schema fails.</send_message>
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_default@: It takes a schema class, an inner object schema, and a fallback value or factory, and returns a new schema wrapping the inner one that supplies that fallback when input is missing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_nonoptio: It takes a schema class, an inner object schema, and optional parameters or an error message, and returns a new schema that wraps the inner one and rejects undefined values.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_success@: The function takes a schema class constructor and an inner object schema, then returns a new wrapper schema instance, built with that constructor, that represents whether validation against the inner schema succeeds.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_pipe@137: It takes a pipeline schema constructor, an input schema, and an output schema that accepts the input's parsed result, and returns a new schema chaining validation from input through output.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_readonly: Given a schema class constructor and an object schema, it builds and returns a new read-only wrapper schema around that inner object schema.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_template: <sentence>Takes a schema class, a list of template parts, and optional settings or an error message, and returns a new template-literal string schema whose type reflects those parts.</sentence>
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_stringFo: This function takes a schema class, a format name, a validation function or regular expression, and optional parameters, and returns a new custom string-format schema that validates strings accordingly.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_custom@1: <answer>It takes a schema class, a validation callback, and optional parameters or an error message, and returns a new custom validation schema that aborts on failure by default.</answer>
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_refine@1: It takes a schema class, a validation function and optional error settings, and returns a new custom-validation schema built from that class with those settings normalized.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_stringbo: Given optional schema building blocks and settings, it returns a validation schema that converts recognized truthy or falsy text, optionally case-insensitive, into a boolean and reports unrecognized values.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_promise@: This function takes a promise schema constructor and an inner object schema, and returns a new promise schema that wraps that inner schema.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/config.ts#config: It optionally takes partial settings, merges them into the shared global configuration object, and returns that global configuration, either updated or unchanged.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/checks.ts#handle: It takes a validation result, a parent parse payload, and a property name; if the result has issues, it adds them to the parent, prefixed with the property path, and returns nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/api.ts#_lazy@142: It takes a schema constructor and a function that produces a schema, and returns a new deferred-evaluation schema built from that constructor and resolved by the function when needed.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/core.ts#$ZodAsyn: This error class takes no arguments and produces an error stating that a promise was encountered during synchronous parsing, advising use of the asynchronous parse method instead.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/core.ts#_@45: This constructor takes a definition object, initializes either a fresh instance of a parent class or the current object with it, runs any queued deferred callbacks, and returns that instance.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/core.ts#config@1: It optionally takes a partial set of settings, merges them into the shared global configuration, and returns the resulting global configuration object.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/core.ts#Definiti: This is not a function but an empty class declaration that inherits everything from its parent, taking no inputs and returning nothing, adding no behavior of its own.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/core.ts#init@22: It takes an instance and a definition, attaches hidden internal metadata recording a trait name, runs an initializer, binds missing prototype methods, stores constructor and definition, returning nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/core.ts#$constru: <final>Takes a name, an initializer callback, and an optional parent class, and returns a named constructor that builds trait-tagged instances, runs deferred setup, and supports trait-based instance checks.</final>
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/doc.ts#indented@: It takes a callback, raises the document's indentation level by one, runs the callback with the document, restores the previous level afterward, and returns nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/doc.ts#compile@3: It takes the object's stored parameter names and code lines, indents and joins the lines into a body, and returns a new dynamically constructed function using those parameters.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/doc.ts#write@20: It takes either a callback, invoking it twice for synchronous and asynchronous modes, or a text block, which it dedents, re-indents to the current level, and appends line by line; it returns nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/doc.ts#Doc@3: This class takes parameter names, collects dedented and indented source lines (optionally generated in both synchronous and asynchronous modes), and compiles them into a new executable function.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/doc.ts#write@19: This function takes a single line of text and writes it to some output destination, returning nothing; the exact destination depends on the implementation behind this signature.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/errors.ts#flatte: This function takes a validation error from a schema library and returns a simplified object that separates top-level error messages from messages grouped by field.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/errors.ts#initia: It takes a validation error object and a list of issues, sets the error's name, attaches the issues as hidden properties, and makes its message a pretty-printed JSON of them; it returns nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/doc.ts#write@18: It takes a writer callback for a mode, used to produce or emit output, and registers or applies it without returning anything.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/errors.ts#get@20: This getter takes no arguments and returns a pretty-printed text representation of a stored definition object, serialized with two-space indentation and a custom replacer for special values.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/errors.ts#flatte: It takes a schema validation error and an optional function that transforms each issue, and returns a flattened object separating top-level errors from per-field error messages.
<final>It takes a validation error and an optional message-transforming function, and returns an object separating top-level errors from errors grouped by their first path segment.</final>
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/errors.ts#format: It takes a validation error from a schema check and returns a nested object mirroring the data's shape, with each level listing the error messages for that location.
It takes a validation error and an optional function that transforms each issue, and returns a nested object mirroring the data's shape, with error messages attached at each field.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/errors.ts#treeif: It takes a schema validation error and returns a nested tree mirroring the validated data's shape, with each level listing its own error messages and its child properties or items.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/errors.ts#proces: It takes a validation error containing a list of issues and recursively descends into nested union, key, and element issues. It returns nothing, instead filing each mapped message into a shared nested error-tree object keyed by the issue's path.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/errors.ts#format: It takes a validation error and an optional message-mapping function, and returns a nested object mirroring the data's shape, listing mapped messages at each field path, flattening union, key, and element sub-errors.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/errors.ts#treeif: Takes a validation error and an optional message-mapping function, and returns a nested tree mirroring the data's shape, with mapped error messages attached at each object property or array index.
It takes a validation error and an optional function for transforming each issue, and returns a nested tree mirroring the data's shape, with error messages attached at each location.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/function.ts#impl: It takes an implementation function and returns an async wrapper that validates its arguments against the input schema, calls it, and validates the awaited result against the output schema.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/function.ts#$Zod: This class takes a definition holding optional argument and return-value schemas and produces wrapped functions, sync or async, that validate their inputs and outputs, plus copies with replaced schemas.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/errors.ts#proces: It takes a validation error's list of issues plus an optional path prefix, recursively unwraps nested union, key, and element issues, and returns nothing, instead filing each mapped message into a shared tree by property name or array index.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/errors.ts#pretti: The function takes a validation error holding multiple issues and returns a readable multi-line string listing each issue's message and location, ordered from shallowest to deepest path.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/function.ts#inpu: It takes a list of argument schemas plus an optional schema for extra trailing arguments, and returns a new function schema with those parameters and the original return type.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/function.ts#outp: It takes a new return-value schema and returns a new function schema of the same class that keeps the original input-argument schema but uses the given return schema.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/function.ts#inpu: It takes a schema describing a function's parameters and returns a new function schema using those parameters while keeping the original return type unchanged.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/function.ts#impl: It takes a function and returns a wrapped version that checks its arguments against an input schema before calling it, then checks the result against an output schema.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/function.ts#inpu: It takes either a list of argument schemas, optionally with a schema for extra trailing arguments, or a single ready-made schema, and returns a new function schema with that input and the original return type.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/function.ts#_fun: It takes no arguments and returns a new validation schema describing a function, whose input and output types can then be specified to validate and wrap calls.
It takes a configuration object listing argument schemas and returns a function schema whose parameters are validated as a fixed tuple of those schemas, with an unspecified return type.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/parse.ts#_parse@: It takes an error class and returns a synchronous validator that checks a value against a schema, returning the parsed output or throwing a validation error (or an error if validation is asynchronous).
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/function.ts#_fun: This takes a configuration object specifying an array of argument schemas and a return schema, and returns a function schema whose parameters form a fixed-length tuple without rest elements.
It takes a configuration object specifying an output schema and returns a function schema that uses the default input type and the given output type.
It takes a configuration object specifying the argument schemas and returns a function schema that validates inputs against them, leaving the return type unconstrained.
It optionally takes an object with an input-arguments schema and an output schema, and returns a typed function schema that validates a function's arguments and return value.
It takes optional input and output type schemas and returns a new function schema, wrapping a list of input schemas as a tuple and defaulting to accepting and returning unknown values.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/parse.ts#_parseA: Given an error class, it returns an asynchronous validator that runs a schema against a value and resolves to the parsed output, or throws an error listing all issues found.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/parse.ts#_safePa: Given an error class, it returns a synchronous validator that takes a schema, a value, and an optional context. The validator yields a success result with parsed data or a failure result with an error; asynchronous validation throws.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/regexes.ts#timeS: It takes an optional precision setting and returns a regular-expression pattern string matching 24-hour clock times: hours and minutes only, with seconds, or with a fixed or flexible number of fractional-second digits.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/parse.ts#_safePa: It takes an error class and returns an asynchronous validator that checks a value against a schema, resolving to either a success result with parsed data or a failure result with an error.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/regexes.ts#emoji: This function takes no arguments and returns a new Unicode-aware regular expression built from a predefined pattern for matching emoji characters.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/regexes.ts#strin: Takes optional minimum and maximum length bounds and returns a regular expression that matches an entire string of any characters, including newlines, whose length falls within those bounds.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/registries.ts#$Z: This class stores metadata for validation schemas, letting callers add, remove, clear, or check entries and look up metadata that is merged with the parent's (excluding the parent's unique identifier).
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/regexes.ts#time@: It takes an options object with an optional fractional-seconds precision setting and returns a regular expression that matches a whole string only if it is a valid time-of-day value.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/registries.ts#ad: This method registers a schema with optional (or required) metadata in a registry, indexes it by any provided ID while rejecting duplicate IDs, and returns the registry for chaining.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/regexes.ts#datet: Given options for fractional-second precision and whether to allow timezone offsets or local times, it returns a regular expression that validates full ISO 8601 date-time strings.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/registries.ts#re: This generic factory takes no arguments and returns a new, empty registry for associating metadata of a chosen type with schemas of a chosen type.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/schemas.ts#runCh: Takes a parse result and a list of validation checks, runs each applicable check (skipping ones after an abort unless conditionally enabled, possibly asynchronously), and returns the updated result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/registries.ts#ge: <final>Given a schema, it returns that schema's stored metadata merged over metadata recursively inherited from its parent schemas (excluding the parent's identifier), or undefined if none exists.</final>
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/registries.ts#re: Given a type definition, this method deletes its stored metadata from the registry, also clearing any associated identifier lookup entry, and returns the registry itself for chaining.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/registries.ts#ha: It takes a structure definition and returns true or false depending on whether that definition is already stored in this object's internal lookup collection.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/schemas.ts#isVal: It takes a token string and an optional expected signing algorithm, and returns true or false depending on whether the token has three parts and a decodable header declaring an algorithm that matches when one is specified.
It takes a string and returns a boolean indicating whether it is valid URL-safe base64, checking its character pattern, then converting it to standard padded base64 and validating that.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/registries.ts#cl: This method takes no arguments, empties the object's two internal lookup tables by replacing them with fresh empty ones, and returns the same object so calls can be chained.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/schemas.ts#handl: Given the parse results from each union option, it returns the output payload with the first successful option's value, or with an added invalid-union issue collecting every option's finalized errors.
It takes a property's parse result, an aggregate result and a property key, merges the property's issues (prefixed with the key) and value into the aggregate, and returns nothing.

It takes one property's validation result, the overall object result, the property name and the original input, then records that property's value or its key-prefixed errors; it returns nothing. Validation failures are ignored when the input value was undefined or absent.
It takes one element's parse result, the overall array parse result and the element's position, adds any element errors tagged with that position, stores the element's value, and returns nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/schemas.ts#isVal: It takes a string and returns a boolean indicating whether it is valid base64: true for empty input, false if the length isn't a multiple of four or decoding fails.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/schemas.ts#parse: It takes a property name, escapes it, and returns a code string that runs that property's schema validator on the matching input value with an empty issue list.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/schemas.ts#handl: It takes a result object plus two parse outcomes and returns that result, with issues from both collected, and, if not aborted, the two parsed values merged, throwing when merging fails.

descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/schemas.ts#handl: It takes one element's parse result, the overall tuple parse result, and a position; it adds that element's errors, labeled with the position, and stores its value there, returning nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/schemas.ts#merge: It takes two values and recursively deep-merges them, returning a success result with the combined value, or a failure result with the path to the first incompatible spot.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/src/v4/core/schemas.ts#handl: It takes a parse result and a schema definition, fills in the definition's default value when the result is undefined, and returns the same result object.
It takes a parse result and its schema, adds an invalid-type issue if the value is undefined and no other errors exist, and returns the same result.
It takes one element's parse result and an accumulating set result, copies any validation issues into the accumulator, adds the element's value to its set, and returns nothing.

descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/errors.cjs#setErrorMap@12: This function takes a mapping of error messages and stores it as the global override for error reporting, returning nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/errors.cjs#getErrorMap@15: This function takes no arguments and returns the currently active custom error-message mapping, which is stored at module level and used to override the default validation error messages.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.cjs#mak: It takes validation issue details, input data, a base location, and a list of message-generating handlers, and returns the issue with its full combined location and a resolved error message.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.cjs#dir: This method takes no arguments and returns nothing; it changes the object's status from valid to dirty, leaving any other status unchanged.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.cjs#Par: This class tracks a validation state (valid, dirty, or aborted) and merges lists or key-value pairs of parse results into one combined result, returning an invalid marker if any part aborted.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.cjs#add: It takes a validation context and raw issue details, builds a complete issue using the context's data, path, and prioritized error message maps, and records it on the context, returning nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.cjs#abo: This method takes no arguments and returns nothing; it marks the object's status as aborted, changing it only if it isn't already in that state.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.cjs#mer: It takes a validation status and a list of key-value pairs whose parts may be pending, waits for each in order, then returns the synchronously merged object result.
It takes a status tracker and a list of parsed key-value result pairs, merges them into a single object, and returns the combined status and object, or an invalid marker if any pair failed.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.cjs#isD: This function takes an object and returns true if that object's status property equals the string "dirty", otherwise false.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.cjs#mer: It takes a status tracker and a list of validation results, returning an invalid marker if any result failed outright, otherwise the collected values with the overall status.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.cjs#OK@: It takes any value and returns an object that marks it as valid, pairing a success status with the original value for use in validation or parsing results.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.cjs#isA: It takes an object and returns true if its status field equals the string "aborted", otherwise false.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.cjs#isV: It takes an object and returns true if that object's status property equals the string "valid", otherwise false.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.cjs#DIR: It takes any value and returns a new object pairing that value with a status label marking it as tainted or not cleanly valid.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.cjs#isA: This function takes any value and returns true if it is a promise in an environment that supports promises, otherwise false.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.js#addI: It takes a validation context and raw issue details, builds a complete issue with an error message chosen from prioritized error maps, and appends it to the context's issue list, returning nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.js#Pars: This class tracks a validation status that can escalate from valid to dirty to aborted, and combines individual parse results into an array or object outcome, returning an invalid marker if any part aborted.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.js#OK@1: This takes any single input and returns a result object that marks it as valid and carries the original input alongside that valid status.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.js#make: It takes validation issue details, the input data, a base location, and a list of message generators, and returns a complete issue object with a combined location and resolved error message.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.js#merg: It takes a validation status tracker and a list of parse results, returning an invalid marker if any result failed, otherwise the collected values with the overall status, marked dirty if needed.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.js#DIRT: This function takes any input and returns a new object pairing that input with a marker flagging it as modified or invalid, but still carrying the data.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.js#isDi: It takes an object and returns a boolean indicating whether that object's status property equals the string "dirty".
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.js#merg: It takes a validation status tracker and a list of parsed key-value results, and returns a combined object with the overall status, or an invalid marker if any entry was aborted.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.js#isAb: This function takes an object and returns true if its state field indicates it was cancelled, and false otherwise.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.js#isVa: It takes an object and returns true if its status property equals the string "valid", otherwise false.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/util.cjs#getParse: It takes any value and returns a fine-grained type label, distinguishing cases like NaN, null, arrays, promises, maps, sets, and dates beyond basic primitive types.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/parseUtil.js#isAs: This takes any value and returns true if the environment supports native asynchronous result objects and the value is one of them; otherwise it returns false.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/util.cjs#assertNe: It accepts a value that should be impossible at runtime, ignores it, and always throws an error instead of returning, typically to enforce exhaustive case handling.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/util.cjs#assertIs: This function accepts a single argument, ignores it entirely, and returns nothing; it likely exists only as a placeholder or compile-time type-checking helper.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/util.cjs#joinValu: It takes a list of values and an optional delimiter, wraps any text entries in single quotes, and returns one string joining them with the delimiter, defaulting to a vertical bar.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/helpers/util.js#getParsed: It takes any value and returns a fine-grained type label, distinguishing not-a-number, null, arrays, promise-like objects, maps, sets, and dates from ordinary objects and other primitives.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/locales/en.js#errorMap@3: Takes a validation issue and its context, then returns an object holding a human-readable English error message chosen by issue type, falling back to the context's default error.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/locales/en.cjs#errorMap@5: It takes a validation issue and its context, then returns an object holding a human-readable English error message tailored to the issue's kind and details.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#handleResult@32: Given a parsing context and a parse result, it returns a success object with the parsed value, or a failure object whose validation error is built lazily and cached.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ParseInputLazyP: This class wraps a parent context, a value, a base path and a key (or list of keys), and lazily builds and caches the full path by appending the key(s) on first access.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#processCreatePa: It takes optional schema configuration options and returns an object with a description and an error-message mapping function, either the one supplied or one built from custom messages.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_getType@79: This method takes an input object carrying data to be validated and returns a classification of that data's runtime type, such as string, number, array, null, or object.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#customMap@61: This function takes a validation issue and its context, and returns an error message. It prefers a custom message, then a "required" or "wrong type" message depending on the failure, and otherwise falls back to the default error.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodType@75: This is the base schema class of a validation library: it takes input data plus optional settings and returns the validated value, throws an error, or returns a success-or-issues result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_getOrReturnCtx: This method takes a parse input and an optional existing context, returning that context if provided, otherwise building a new one from the input's data, detected type, path, parent, and schema error map.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_processInputPa: It takes a validation input object and returns a fresh parse status alongside a context bundling the data, its detected type, error map, path, and parent information.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parseSync@105: It takes an input value, runs the internal parsing logic on it, and returns the parse result, throwing an error if that result is asynchronous rather than immediate.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parseAsync@112: It takes an input value, runs the synchronous parsing logic on it, and returns a promise that resolves to the parsing result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#safeParse@122: It takes input data and optional settings such as an error map and path, validates the data synchronously against the schema, and returns a result indicating success with parsed data or failure with errors.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#safeParseAsync@: It asynchronously validates input data against a schema, optionally using a custom error map and path, and returns a result object indicating success with parsed data or failure with errors.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#getIssuePropert: This function takes a value and returns an issue-details object: it wraps a text or missing message, calls a message-producing function with the value, or returns a provided object unchanged.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#parseAsync@179: It takes input data and optional settings, asynchronously validates them, and returns the validated value on success or throws the validation error on failure.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#setError@216: This function takes no arguments and records a custom validation issue on the current validation context, using details derived from the value being checked, returning nothing meaningful.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#refine@202: It takes a validation predicate, which may be synchronous or asynchronous, plus an optional error message, object, or message-generating function. It returns a new schema that reports a custom issue whenever the predicate fails.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#refinement@240: It takes a validation predicate and either issue details or a function producing them, and returns a new schema that reports that issue whenever a value fails the predicate.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#\"~validate\"@1: Validates input data against a schema and returns either the parsed value or a list of issues, trying synchronous parsing first and falling back to asynchronous parsing when necessary.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#parse@116: It takes an input value plus optional settings, validates it against a schema, and returns the validated value on success or throws the validation failure otherwise.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#superRefine@258: It takes a custom validation callback that can report its own issues and returns a new schema that applies that validation on top of the existing one.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#optional@295: This method takes no arguments and returns a new schema that wraps the current one so it also accepts an undefined value, carrying over the original schema's configuration.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_refinement@251: This method takes a validation check and returns a new schema that wraps the current one, applying that check as an additional refinement step during parsing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#nullish@301: This method takes no arguments and returns a new version of the current schema that also accepts both null and undefined values.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#nullable@298: This method takes the current validation schema and returns a new schema wrapping it, so that null values are accepted alongside whatever the original schema permits.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#array@304: This method takes no arguments and returns a new array schema whose elements must each satisfy the current schema, turning a single-item validator into a list validator.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#promise@307: This method takes no arguments and returns a new validation schema that expects an asynchronous result resolving to a value matching the current schema, reusing its existing configuration.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#or@310: It takes another validation schema and returns a new union schema that accepts values matching either the current schema or the provided one, preserving the current schema's configuration.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#default@324: This method takes a fallback value or a function producing one and returns a new schema that wraps the current one, substituting that fallback when the input is undefined.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#brand@333: Takes no arguments and returns a new branded schema that wraps the current schema, carrying over its configuration, so validated values get a nominal type tag.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#and@313: It takes another validation schema and returns a new combined schema requiring input to satisfy both the current schema and the given one, carrying over the current schema's configuration.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#describe@349: It takes a text description and returns a new instance of the same schema type, copying the original's definition but with that description attached, leaving the original unchanged.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#transform@316: It takes a transformation function and returns a new validation schema that wraps the current one, applying that function to successfully parsed values to produce the output.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#catch@340: It takes a fallback value or a function that produces one, and returns a new schema wrapping the current one that yields that fallback whenever validation fails.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#pipe@356: This method takes a target schema and returns a new pipeline schema that first validates input with the current schema, then passes the result to the target for further validation.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#datetimeRegex@4: It takes an options object and returns a regular expression matching a full ISO 8601 date-time string, with the timezone suffix optionally omittable or allowed as a numeric offset.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#timeRegex@428: It takes a set of time-format options and returns a regular expression that matches an entire string only if it is a valid time in that format.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#isOptional@362: This method takes no arguments and returns a boolean saying whether the schema accepts an undefined value, which is checked by trying to validate undefined without throwing an error.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#isNullable@365: This method takes no arguments and returns a boolean showing whether the schema accepts a null value, determined by validating null without throwing an error.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#isValidIP@441: Takes an address string and an optional protocol version, and returns true if the string is a valid address for that version, or for either version if none is given.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#readonly@359: This method takes no arguments and returns a new schema that wraps the current one, so parsed results are marked immutable (frozen) while keeping the original validation rules.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#timeRegexSource: It takes an options object with an optional fractional-seconds precision and returns a regular-expression pattern string matching 24-hour times, with seconds and their decimal digits optional or required depending on that precision.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#isValidCidr@477: It takes an address string and an optional IP version, and returns true if the string is valid CIDR notation for that version (or either version if unspecified), otherwise false.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#isValidJWT@450: It takes a token string and an optional expected algorithm, and returns a true/false result. It checks the token's format and decodes its header. The result is true only if the header is a valid object, any declared type is JWT, an algorithm is present, and that algorithm matches the expected one when given.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@487: It takes an input value, optionally converting it to text, verifies it is a string, and runs configured length and format checks, returning a validation result with any recorded issues.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodString@486: Takes an input value, optionally converts it to a string, verifies it is a string, and checks configured constraints such as length and format, returning a validation result with any issues.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_regex@817: This method takes a regular expression, a validation type, and an optional error message, and returns a new string schema that rejects values not matching the pattern with an invalid-string error.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#email@830: This method takes an optional custom error message and returns a new string schema with an added rule requiring the value to be a valid email address.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#uuid@839: It takes an optional custom error message and returns a new string schema with an added check requiring the value to be a valid UUID.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_addCheck@824: It takes a validation rule and returns a new string schema with the same configuration plus that rule appended, leaving the original schema unchanged.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#emoji@836: It takes an optional custom error message and returns a new string schema that additionally requires the value to contain only emoji characters.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#url@833: It takes an optional custom error message and returns a new string schema that also requires the value to be a valid URL.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#cuid2@848: This method takes an optional custom error message and returns a new string schema that also requires the value to be a valid CUID2 identifier.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#base64url@857: It takes an optional custom error message and returns a new string validator that additionally requires the value to be valid URL-safe base64 encoding.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#nanoid@842: It takes an optional custom error message and returns a new string schema that also requires the value to be a valid Nano ID.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#cuid@845: It takes an optional custom error message and returns a new string schema that also requires the value to be a valid collision-resistant unique identifier (CUID).
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ulid@851: It takes an optional custom error message or options and returns a new string schema that also requires the value to be a valid ULID identifier.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#base64@854: This method takes an optional custom error message and returns a new string schema that also requires the value to be valid base64-encoded text.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ip@867: This method takes optional settings or an error message and returns a new string validator that also requires the value to be a valid IP address.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#jwt@864: This method takes optional settings or an error message and returns a new string schema that also requires the value to be a valid JSON Web Token.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#duration@908: It takes an optional custom error message and returns a new string schema that also checks the value is a valid ISO 8601 duration.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#datetime@873: This method takes either a custom error message or a settings object for precision, timezone offset, local time, and message, and returns a new string schema requiring valid date-time format.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#date@891: It takes an optional custom error message and returns a new copy of the schema with an added check requiring the value to be a valid date.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#regex@911: It takes a regular-expression pattern and an optional error message, and returns a new validation schema that also requires values to match that pattern.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#time@894: This method accepts either a custom error message or a settings object with optional precision and message, and returns a new string validator that also requires a valid time format.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#cidr@870: This method takes optional settings, such as a custom error message, and returns a new string schema that also validates the value as a CIDR network address notation.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#startsWith@926: This method takes a required prefix and an optional error message, and returns a new string validator that also requires values to begin with that prefix.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#includes@918: It takes a substring and optional settings for a starting position and custom error message, and returns a new string schema requiring the input to contain that substring.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#endsWith@933: This method takes a required suffix and an optional error message, and returns a new string validator that also requires values to end with that suffix.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#trim@967: Taking no arguments, it returns a new string validation schema that copies the current configuration and appends a rule that strips leading and trailing whitespace from input.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#toLowerCase@973: This method takes no arguments and returns a new string schema that copies the current configuration and adds a transformation converting input text to lowercase.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#min@940: It takes a minimum length and an optional error message, and returns a new validator that also requires values to meet that minimum length.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#length@954: This method takes a required exact size and an optional custom error message, adds an exact-size validation rule, and returns a new validator including that rule.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#max@947: It takes a maximum length and an optional error message, and returns a new validation schema that also enforces that maximum, attaching the message when the check fails.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodNumber@1073: This class defines a chainable number validation schema that takes an input value, optionally coerces it, checks type, integer, range, divisibility and finiteness rules, and returns a status with the value.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#toUpperCase@979: This method takes no arguments and returns a new string validation schema that copies the existing configuration and adds a step converting values to uppercase.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#floatSafeRemain: It takes a number and a divisor and returns the remainder of dividing them, scaling both to integers first so decimal values avoid floating-point rounding errors.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#gt@1169: It takes a number and an optional error message, and returns a new validation schema requiring values to be strictly greater than that number.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@1080: It takes an input value, optionally converts it to a number, and validates it against integer, range, multiple, and finiteness rules. It returns the value with a validity status, or an invalid marker if it isn't a number.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#gte@1166: It takes a threshold value and an optional custom error message, and returns a new validation schema requiring values to be greater than or equal to that threshold.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_addCheck@1192: It takes a validation rule and returns a new numeric schema that copies the current configuration with that rule added to its existing rules, leaving the original unchanged.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#lte@1172: It takes a numeric limit and an optional error message, and returns a new validation schema requiring values to be less than or equal to that limit.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#int@1198: It takes an optional custom error message and returns a new number schema that also requires the value to be an integer, failing validation with that message otherwise.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#lt@1175: It takes a numeric bound and an optional error message, and returns a new schema that requires values to be strictly less than that bound.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#setLimit@1178: It takes a limit type, a boundary value, an inclusivity flag, and an optional error message, and returns a new numeric validation schema with that bound added to its existing checks.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#nonpositive@122: It takes an optional custom error message and returns a new schema that also requires the number to be zero or negative, attaching that message to the check.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#positive@1204: It takes an optional custom error message and returns a new number schema requiring values strictly greater than zero, reporting that message when validation fails.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#nonnegative@122: It takes an optional custom error message and returns a new copy of the numeric validation schema that also requires values to be greater than or equal to zero.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#negative@1212: This method takes an optional custom error message and returns a new numeric validation schema that requires values to be strictly less than zero.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#finite@1243: It takes an optional custom error message and returns a new number schema that additionally rejects infinite values, reporting that message when validation fails.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#safe@1249: It takes an optional error message and returns a new number schema requiring values to fall within the safe integer range, inclusive at both ends.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@1319: It takes an input, optionally converts it to an arbitrary-precision integer, and returns a validation result after checking type, minimum, maximum and divisibility constraints, recording any violations.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#multipleOf@1236: It takes a divisor and an optional error message, and returns a new validation schema that also requires numbers to be exact multiples of that divisor.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodBigInt@1313: This schema class validates input as a big integer, optionally coercing it, applies chained bound and divisibility rules, and returns the value with a validity status and any recorded issues.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#setLimit@1401: Given a limit type, a boundary value, an inclusivity flag and an optional error message, it returns a new big-integer validator that copies the current one and adds that bound check.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#negative@1429: This method takes an optional error message and returns a new big-integer schema that also requires values to be strictly less than zero, reporting that message on failure.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_getInvalidInpu: Given a value being validated, it records an error noting that a big integer was expected but a different type was received, then returns a marker signaling validation failure.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_addCheck@1415: It takes a validation rule and returns a new big-integer schema with the same configuration as the original, plus that rule added to its existing rules.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#nonnegative@144: It takes an optional error message and returns a new big-integer schema whose validation requires values to be zero or greater, reporting that message when the check fails.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#positive@1421: This method takes an optional error message and returns a new big-integer schema that also requires the value to be strictly greater than zero.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#nonpositive@143: It takes an optional custom error message and returns a new big-integer validation schema that also requires the value to be less than or equal to zero.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodBoolean@1490: This validation method takes an input value, optionally coerces it to a boolean, and returns a success result holding the value if it is a boolean, otherwise records a type-mismatch issue and returns an invalid marker.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#multipleOf@1453: It takes a divisor and an optional error message, and returns a new schema that adds a validation rule requiring the input number to be an exact multiple of that divisor.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@1491: This function takes an input value, optionally converting it to true or false first, and returns a success result if it is a boolean, otherwise records a type-mismatch error and returns an invalid marker.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_addCheck@1578: It takes a validation rule and returns a new date schema that copies the current configuration and appends that rule to its existing rules, leaving the original unchanged.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#min@1584: It takes an earliest allowed date and an optional error message, and returns a new date validator that rejects dates earlier than that minimum.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodDate@1516: This class defines a date validation schema: it takes an input value, optionally converts it to a date, and checks that it is a valid date within any earliest/latest bounds. It returns a validated copy of the date, or reports type, invalid-date, or range errors.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@1517: It takes an input value, optionally converts it to a date, and checks that it is a valid date within any configured earliest and latest bounds. It returns an invalid marker, or a fresh copy of the date with a status flagging any range violations.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#max@1591: It takes a latest allowed date and an optional error message, and returns a new date validator that rejects dates later than that limit.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@1629: <answer>Takes an input wrapper and checks whether its data is a symbol, returning a success result with the data if so, otherwise recording a type-mismatch issue and returning invalid.</answer>
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodUndefined@16: It takes an input to validate and returns a success result with the value if it is undefined; otherwise it records a type-mismatch issue and returns an invalid marker.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@1651: <final>It takes a parsing input and returns a successful result with the value if it is undefined; otherwise it records a type-mismatch error and returns an invalid marker.</final>
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@1673: It takes a parsing input and checks whether its value is null; if so, it returns a success result carrying that value, otherwise it records a type-mismatch issue and returns an invalid marker.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodSymbol@1628: This validator schema takes an input value and returns it as a successful result if it is a symbol; otherwise it records a type-mismatch error and returns an invalid marker.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodNull@1672: This schema validator takes an input and returns a successful result containing the data if it is null, otherwise it records a type-mismatch issue and returns an invalid result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@1700: It takes a parsing input object and returns a successful parse result holding that input's data unchanged, so any value passes validation without checks.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodNever@1728: This schema validator takes any input value, always records an invalid-type error saying nothing was expected, and returns an invalid result, so no value ever passes.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodAny@1694: This schema type accepts any input value without validation and returns it unchanged as a successful parse result, carrying a marker that distinguishes it from other schema types.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@1729: Given any input, it always records a type-mismatch issue stating that no value is permitted, then returns an invalid result, so validation never succeeds.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@1747: This validation method takes an input value and returns a success result if it is undefined; otherwise it records a type-mismatch error expecting an empty value and returns an invalid marker.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodVoid@1746: This validator takes an input value and accepts it only if it's undefined, returning it as valid; otherwise it records a type-mismatch issue expecting void and returns an invalid result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodArray@1768: This schema class takes an input value, checks that it is an array within any configured exact, minimum, or maximum length limits, and returns a combined parse result from validating each element.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@1769: It takes an input value, checks that it is an array within the configured length limits, and validates every element against the element schema. It returns the merged parse result, or a promise of it in async mode.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodUnknown@1711: This schema type accepts any input value without validation and returns it unchanged, wrapped in a successful parse result, while marking itself as representing an unknown type.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#length@1849: It takes a required element count and an optional error message, and returns a new array schema copying the current settings that additionally requires exactly that many elements.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#max@1843: It takes a maximum element count and an optional error message, and returns a new array schema identical to the original but rejecting arrays longer than that limit.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#min@1837: It takes a minimum element count and an optional error message, and returns a new array validation schema that copies the current settings and enforces that minimum length.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#nonempty@1855: It takes an optional custom error message and returns a new validation schema requiring the value to contain at least one character or element, reporting that message on failure.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@1956: It validates an input value against an object schema, checking each defined property and handling unexpected keys by stripping, passing through, rejecting, or validating them, then returns the merged parse result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#deepPartialify@: It takes a validation schema and returns a copy in which every object field, at any depth, is optional. It recurses through arrays, tuples, optional wrappers and nullable wrappers, and returns any other schema type unchanged.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodObject@1901: This is an object-schema validator class that accepts an input value, checks each declared property against its schema, and handles unknown keys by stripping, passing through, rejecting, or catch-all validating them, returning the parse result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_getCached@1948: This method takes no arguments and returns an object holding a schema's shape and its list of keys, computing it once and reusing the stored result on later calls.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#strip@2072: Takes no arguments and returns a new copy of the object schema, configured to silently remove any unrecognized keys from parsed input instead of keeping them or raising errors.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#passthrough@207: It takes no arguments and returns a copy of the current object schema that keeps unrecognized keys in parsed output instead of stripping them or rejecting them.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#strict@2051: Takes an optional custom error message and returns a new object schema that rejects unknown keys, using that message for unrecognized-key errors and default messages otherwise.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#extend@2101: It takes a set of additional field definitions and returns a new object schema with the original settings, whose fields combine the existing ones with the new ones, overriding any duplicates.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#omit@2204: It takes a set of field names to exclude and returns a new object schema with the same settings, keeping only the fields not marked for removal.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#setKey@2162: It takes a property name and a validation schema, and returns a new object schema that includes that property, defined by the given schema, alongside the existing ones.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#pick@2192: It takes a set of keys marked true and returns a new object schema with the original settings, keeping only the requested fields that already exist in the current schema.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#deepPartial@221: This method takes no arguments and returns a new version of the current schema in which every property, including those in nested structures, is recursively made optional.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#partial@2222: It takes an optional set of selected field names and returns a new object schema in which those fields, or every field if none are given, become optional.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#required@2238: Given an optional selection of field names, it returns a new object schema where the selected fields (or all fields, if none are given) have every optional wrapper removed, making them required.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#handleResults@2: It takes a list of validation outcomes from union alternatives and returns the first fully valid one, else the first partially valid one with its issues recorded, else an invalid marker after recording a combined union error.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodUnion@2290: It takes an input value and tries each alternative schema in turn, returning the first fully valid result, else the first partially valid one, else an invalid marker with all errors.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#catchall@2186: It takes a schema and returns a new copy of the current object schema that validates any unknown, undeclared keys against that schema, leaving the original unchanged.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@2291: It takes an input value and tests it against several alternative schemas, synchronously or asynchronously, returning the first fully valid result, else a partially valid one, else an invalid marker with collected errors.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodDiscriminate: This schema validates an input object by reading a shared tag property, choosing the matching object schema from a precomputed lookup, and returning that schema's parse result, or an invalid result with recorded errors.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodIntersection: It takes an input value, validates it against two schemas (synchronously or asynchronously), and returns their merged parsed result, or an invalid marker if either fails or results conflict.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#mergeValues@251: It takes two values and recursively merges them when they are compatible (identical values, objects, equal-length arrays, or equal dates), returning a success flag plus the merged result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@2440: It takes an input value and checks that it is an object. It then uses a designated key's value to pick a matching schema, which it uses to validate the input synchronously or asynchronously. It returns that result, or an invalid marker with a recorded issue.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#keyof@2258: Called on an object validation schema with no arguments, it returns a new enumeration schema whose allowed values are exactly the property names defined in that object's shape.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodTuple@2617: This validates an input array against a fixed sequence of per-position schemas plus an optional schema for extra elements, returning the parsed array or an invalid result with recorded issues.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@2562: It takes an input and validates it against two schemas, synchronously or asynchronously, then returns their merged result, or an invalid marker if either fails or the results conflict.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#getDiscriminato: The function takes a validation schema, recursively unwraps wrapper types, and returns an array of all literal values it can match, or an empty array if none apply.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@2618: This validates an input value as a fixed-length tuple, checking positional elements against their schemas and extras against an optional rest schema. It returns the merged parse result, possibly asynchronously, or an invalid marker.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodRecord@2688: This validation schema takes an input value, confirms it is an object, checks every key and value against their configured schemas, and returns the validated object or an invalid result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#rest@2669: It takes a schema for additional trailing elements and returns a new tuple schema with the same settings, now allowing any number of extra items matching that schema.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@2750: It validates an input expected to be a Map by checking each key and value against their schemas. It returns a result holding a new Map of parsed entries, or an invalid marker, synchronously or as a promise.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#create@2725: This factory method takes either a key schema, value schema, and options, or just a value schema and options, and returns a new record schema whose keys default to strings.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@2695: It takes an input value, checks that it is an object, validates every key and value against the configured schemas, and returns the merged result (synchronously or asynchronously), or an invalid marker.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodMap@2743: This validator takes an input value, checks that it is a map, validates every key and value against their respective schemas, and returns a new validated map (possibly asynchronously) or an invalid result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodSet@2811: This validator takes an input value, checks that it is a set within optional size limits, validates each element against an element schema, and returns a new validated set or an invalid result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#finalizeSet@285: It takes a list of validation results and returns either an invalid marker if any failed, or the overall status with a set of their values, flagging any partial issues.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#handleParsed@25: It takes two parse results for an intersection type and returns an invalid marker if either aborted or their values can't be merged, otherwise the merged value with combined status.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@2903: It takes an input value, checks that it is a function, and returns a wrapped version that validates arguments and return values against schemas, supporting asynchronous results.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@2812: It takes an input value and checks that it is a set within configured size limits, validating every element against a schema. It returns a new set of parsed elements with a validity status, or an invalid marker, either directly or as a promise when running asynchronously.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#makeArgsIssue@2: It takes a function call's arguments and the validation error they caused, and returns a validation issue reporting invalid arguments, located at the current path and formatted using the available error-message maps.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#max@2875: Given a maximum element count and an optional error message, it returns a new set validation schema that copies the original's settings and rejects sets exceeding that size.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#makeReturnsIssu: It takes a function's returned value and a validation error, and builds a validation issue reporting an invalid return type at the current path, using whichever error-message maps are available.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#min@2869: It takes a minimum element count and an optional error message, and returns a new set-validation schema that copies the current settings but requires at least that many elements.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodFunction@289: This schema class takes a function and returns a wrapped version that validates its arguments and return value against defined schemas, throwing validation errors on mismatch, with async support.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#size@2881: It takes a required length and an optional error message, constrains the value to exactly that length by setting equal minimum and maximum bounds, and returns the updated validation schema.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#parameters@2977: It takes no arguments and returns the stored schema describing the function's expected argument list, read from the object's internal definition.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#args@2983: It takes any number of argument schemas and returns a new function schema, copying the existing configuration but expecting those arguments in order, with any extra arguments accepted.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#returnType@2980: This method takes no arguments and returns the schema describing the expected return value of a function type, read from the object's internal definition.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#implement@2995: It takes a function, runs it through the schema's validation, and returns a wrapped version that checks the function's inputs and outputs against the declared types whenever it's called.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#create@3003: This factory takes optional argument and return-value schemas plus configuration options, and returns a new function-validation schema. Missing arguments default to any number of unknown values, and a missing return type defaults to unknown.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#returns@2989: It takes a schema describing a function's return value and returns a new function schema that keeps all existing settings but uses that return schema instead.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#strictImplement: It takes a function, runs it through the schema's validation to produce a wrapped version that checks its inputs and outputs, and returns that validated function.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@3017: It takes parse input, lazily retrieves the deferred schema from a getter, and returns that schema's validation result for the same data, path, and parent context.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodLazy@3013: This class defines a deferred validation schema that calls a stored function to obtain the real schema only when needed, then validates the input with it and returns that result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodLiteral@3031: This schema validator checks whether an input exactly equals one specific expected value, returning a valid result with that input if so, or recording an invalid-literal error otherwise.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#createZodEnum@3: This function takes a list of allowed values and optional configuration settings, and returns a new enumeration schema that validates input against exactly those values.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodEnum@3063: Validates that an input is a string from a fixed set of allowed values, returning it on success or an error otherwise, and offers ways to list, subset, or exclude values.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@3032: It takes a parsing input and checks whether its data exactly equals an expected fixed value, returning a valid result containing that data, or recording a mismatch issue and returning an invalid marker.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#exclude@3120: It takes a list of values to remove and optional configuration overrides, and returns a new enumeration schema containing only the original options not in that list.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@3064: It takes a parse input and checks that its value is a string from an allowed set. It returns the value marked valid if so, otherwise it records a type or enum-mismatch issue and returns an invalid marker.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@3130: It takes a parsing input and checks that its value is a string or number belonging to a native enumeration's valid values. It returns the value as successful, otherwise records a type or enum-value issue and returns an invalid marker.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#extract@3114: It takes a list of allowed values and optional configuration overrides, and returns a new enumeration schema restricted to those values, keeping the original schema's settings unless overridden.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#_parse@3172: It takes an input value and returns a successful result wrapping a promise that validates the resolved value against an inner schema, or an invalid result when synchronous parsing receives a non-promise.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodPromise@3168: This promise schema takes an input value, rejects it if it isn't a promise during synchronous parsing, and otherwise returns a promise resolving to the inner schema's validated result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v3/types.cjs#ZodNativeEnum@3: This schema class validates input against a native enumeration, rejecting non-string/non-number or unlisted values with an error, otherwise returning the value as valid; it also exposes the enum.
