descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/api.js#_catch@767: It takes a schema class, an inner type, and a fallback value or function, and returns a new schema that wraps the inner type and supplies that fallback when validation fails.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/api.js#_default@745: It takes a schema class, an inner type and a fallback value, and returns a new schema wrapping that type with a default value, calling the fallback each time if it's a function.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/api.js#_pipe@774: It takes a constructor along with an input and an output, and returns a new instance of that constructor configured as a pipe connecting the given input to the output.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/api.js#_readonly@781: This function takes a schema class and an inner type, and returns a new instance of that class configured as a read-only wrapper around the given inner type.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/api.js#_promise@800: This function takes a schema class and an inner type, and returns a new instance of that class configured as a promise schema wrapping the given inner type.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/api.js#_lazy@794: This function takes a schema class and a deferred-retrieval callback, and returns a new instance of that class configured as a lazy type that resolves its definition through the callback.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/api.js#_templateLite: It takes a schema class, a list of template parts and optional settings, and returns a new template-literal schema instance built from those parts with the settings normalized.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/api.js#_custom@806: It takes a schema class, a validation callback and optional settings, then returns a new custom-check schema that uses the callback and aborts on failure unless told otherwise.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/api.js#_refine@825: It takes a schema class, a custom validation function, and optional parameters, and returns a new schema instance configured as a custom check using that function and normalized parameters.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/api.js#_stringFormat: It takes a schema class, a format name, a validator function or regular expression, and optional parameters, and returns a new string-format validation schema built from them.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/api.js#_stringbool@8: It takes optional schema classes and configuration options, and returns a validation schema that turns strings matching configurable true-like or false-like words, optionally case-insensitively, into booleans and rejects anything else.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/core.cjs#init@11: It takes an instance and a definition object, sets up hidden internal metadata, records a trait name, runs an initializer, and binds missing prototype methods onto the instance; it returns nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/core.cjs#$constructo: Takes a type name, an initialization routine, and optional parent-class settings, and returns a named constructor that builds trait-tagged instances and recognizes membership by those traits.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/checks.cjs#handleChe: Given a validation result, an accumulating payload, and a property name, it appends any issues from the result to the payload, prefixed with that property's path, returning nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/core.js#$constructor: Given a name, an initialization routine, and optional parent options, it returns a named constructor that builds trait-tagged instances and recognizes instances by their recorded traits during type checks.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/core.cjs#$ZodAsyncEr: This error class takes no arguments and produces an error whose message says a promise was encountered during synchronous parsing, advising use of the asynchronous parse method instead.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/core.cjs#Definition@: This is an empty class declaration, not a function: it takes no inputs and returns nothing, simply defining a subclass that inherits all behavior from its parent unchanged.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/core.cjs#_@33: This constructor takes a definition object, initializes either the current instance or a fresh subclass instance with it, runs any queued deferred setup callbacks, and returns the initialized instance.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/core.cjs#config@63: It takes an optional object of settings, merges them into the shared global configuration if provided, and returns the current global configuration object.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/core.js#config@57: It takes an optional set of settings, merges them into the shared global configuration if provided, and returns the resulting global configuration object.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/core.js#$ZodAsyncErr: This error class takes no arguments and produces an error object whose message says a promise appeared during a synchronous parse, advising the asynchronous parsing method instead.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/doc.cjs#compile@30: It takes the stored parameter names and source lines, indents each line, joins them into a function body, and returns a newly constructed runtime function built from them.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/doc.cjs#indented@11: It takes a callback, increases the object's indentation level by one, runs the callback with the object, then restores the previous level; it returns nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/doc.cjs#write@16: This method takes either a callback, which it invokes twice for synchronous and asynchronous modes, or a text block, which it dedents, reindents, and appends line by line, returning nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/doc.js#Doc@1: This class takes a list of parameter names, accumulates dedented, indentation-aware source lines (also via callbacks run for both sync and async modes), and compiles them into a runnable function.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/doc.cjs#Doc@4: This class takes a list of parameter names, collects code text as dedented, indentation-aware lines (including callback-generated sync and async variants), and compiles it into a new runtime function.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/errors.cjs#get@45: This getter takes no arguments and returns a pretty-printed, two-space-indented text serialization of a stored definition object, using a custom replacer to handle values standard serialization can't.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/errors.cjs#flattenEr: It takes a validation error with a list of issues and an optional message-formatting callback, and returns an object separating top-level form messages from messages grouped by first field name.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/errors.cjs#treeifyEr: This function takes a validation error and an optional message formatter, and returns a nested tree mirroring the data's structure, with each field or array item holding its formatted error messages.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/errors.cjs#initializ: It takes a validation error object and a list of issues, then configures the object in place with a name, hidden internal and issue properties, a message that pretty-prints the issues as formatted JSON, and string conversion; it returns nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/errors.cjs#formatErr: It takes a validation error with a list of issues and an optional message-mapping function, and returns a nested object mirroring the data's structure, with error messages collected at each field.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/errors.cjs#processEr: The function takes a validation error with a list of issues, recursively unpacks nested union, key and element issues, and records each mapped message into a shared path-keyed error tree, returning nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/errors.js#formatErro: It takes a validation error containing a list of issues, plus an optional message-transforming function, and returns a nested object mirroring the data's shape, with error messages collected at each path.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/errors.js#treeifyErr: It takes a validation error containing issues and an optional message-formatting function, and returns a nested tree mirroring the data's shape, with each node holding error messages for that location.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/errors.cjs#prettifyE: It takes a validation error with a list of issues and returns a readable multi-line string listing each issue's message and location, ordered from shallowest to deepest path.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/errors.js#flattenErr: It takes a validation error with its list of issues and an optional formatter, and returns those issues grouped into top-level form messages and per-field message lists keyed by first path segment.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/function.cjs#$ZodFun: Built from optional argument and return-value schemas, this function-schema class wraps a supplied function, synchronous or asynchronous, so its arguments and result are validated, and returns that guarded wrapper.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/errors.js#prettifyEr: It takes a validation error with a list of issues, sorts them by path depth, and returns a readable multi-line string showing each message and, when present, its dotted location.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/function.cjs#impleme: It takes a function and returns a wrapped version that validates its arguments against an input schema and its result against an output schema, throwing an error if either check fails.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/errors.cjs#processEr: The function takes a validation error with its list of issues and an optional base path, recursively flattening nested union, key, and element issues. It returns nothing, instead placing each mapped message into a shared tree that mirrors the object and array structure of the failing data.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/function.cjs#input@6: It takes either a list of argument schemas with an optional trailing rest schema, or a single schema, and returns a new function schema using it as input while keeping the original output.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/function.cjs#impleme: It takes a function and returns an asynchronous wrapper that validates its arguments against an input schema, calls the function, and validates the result against an output schema.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/function.js#$ZodFunc: This class takes a function definition with optional argument and return schemas, and returns wrappers that validate a supplied function's inputs and outputs, synchronously or asynchronously, plus builders for new definitions.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/function.cjs#output@: It takes a schema for a function's return value and returns a new function schema of the same kind, keeping the existing argument definition but using the given return type.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/function.cjs#_functi: It takes an optional configuration of input and output schemas and returns a new function-schema object. Array inputs become a tuple schema, and missing values default to accepting any arguments and returning unknown.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/function.js#input@38: This method accepts either a list of argument schemas with an optional rest schema, or a single input schema, and returns a new function schema with that input and the same output.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/function.js#implemen: <protocol:aside>Summarize the function in one sentence (≤30 words).</protocol:aside> It takes a function and returns a wrapped version that validates its arguments against an input schema and its result against an output schema, throwing errors when validation fails.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/parse.cjs#_safeParse: Given an optional error class, it returns a function that synchronously validates a value against a schema and returns either the parsed data or an error object listing the validation issues.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/function.js#implemen: It takes a function and returns an asynchronous wrapper that validates incoming arguments against an optional input schema, calls the original, then validates its result against an optional output schema.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/function.js#_functio: It takes an optional configuration with input and output schemas and returns a new function schema, converting a list of inputs into a tuple and defaulting unspecified parts to unknown values.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/parse.cjs#_parseAsyn: Given an error class, it produces an asynchronous validator that runs a schema against a value, returning the parsed result or throwing an error listing the validation issues.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/parse.cjs#_safeParse: Given an error class, it returns an asynchronous validator that checks a value against a schema and resolves to either a success result with parsed data or a failure containing finalized issues.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/parse.js#_safeParse@: Given an optional error class, it produces a function that synchronously validates a value against a schema, returning either the parsed data with a success flag or a failure carrying an error.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/parse.js#_parse@4: It takes an error class and returns a synchronous validator that checks a value against a schema, returning the parsed value or throwing an error listing validation issues.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/parse.js#_parseAsync: Given an error class, it produces an asynchronous validator that checks a value against a schema and returns the parsed result, throwing an error listing all issues if validation fails.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/parse.cjs#_parse@30: Given an error class, it returns a synchronous validator that runs a schema on a value and returns the parsed result, throwing a formatted error on validation issues or asynchronous schemas.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/regexes.cjs#emoji@42: This function takes no arguments and returns a new Unicode-aware regular expression built from a predefined pattern that matches emoji characters.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/parse.js#_safeParseA: Given an error class, it produces an asynchronous validator that checks a value against a schema and returns either a success result with the data or a failure result with an error built from the collected issues.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/regexes.cjs#time@73: It takes a set of options and returns a regular expression that matches an entire string only if the whole string is a valid time in the configured format.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/regexes.js#emoji@35: This function takes no arguments and returns a new Unicode-aware regular expression, built from a predefined pattern, for matching emoji characters.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/regexes.cjs#datetime: It takes an options object specifying fractional-second precision and whether local times or numeric timezone offsets are allowed, and returns a regular expression validating ISO 8601 datetime strings.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/regexes.js#string@80: Takes optional minimum and maximum length settings and returns a regular expression matching an entire string of any characters within those bounds, or any length if none are given.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/regexes.cjs#string@8: It takes an optional object with minimum and maximum lengths and returns a regular expression matching any whole string, newlines included, within those bounds, or of any length if omitted.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/regexes.js#time@66: This function takes configuration options and returns a regular expression that matches an entire string only if it is a time value in the format those options specify.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/registries.cjs#add@1: This method registers a schema with optional metadata, indexes it by the metadata's identifier if present (rejecting duplicates), and returns the registry itself for chaining.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/registries.cjs#clear: This method resets the object's two internal lookup tables to new empty ones, takes no arguments, and returns the object itself so calls can be chained.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/regexes.cjs#timeSour: It takes an options object with an optional precision setting and returns a regular-expression pattern string matching 24-hour clock times, with seconds and fractional digits governed by that precision.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/regexes.js#datetime@: It takes options for fractional-second precision and for allowing local (no zone) or numeric-offset times, and returns a regular expression that validates ISO 8601 date-time strings.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/registries.cjs#get@3: Given a schema, it returns the schema's stored metadata, recursively merged over metadata inherited from its parent schemas, excluding any inherited identifier, or nothing if none exists.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/registries.cjs#regis: This function takes no arguments and returns a newly created, empty registry object for associating metadata with validation schemas.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/registries.cjs#has@4: This method takes a key and returns a boolean showing whether that key is present in the object's internal lookup collection.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/registries.cjs#$ZodR: This class is a registry mapping schemas to metadata with unique identifier lookup, supporting add, remove, clear, and membership checks, and returning metadata merged with parent-inherited values (excluding identifiers).
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/registries.cjs#remov: This method takes a schema, deletes it and its associated metadata from the registry, also clearing any lookup entry keyed by that metadata's identifier, and returns the registry for chaining.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/registries.js#regist: This function takes no arguments and returns a newly created, empty registry for associating metadata with validation schemas.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#runCheck: It takes a validation payload, a list of checks, and an optional context, runs each applicable check while tracking aborting issues, and returns the payload, or a promise of it if any check is asynchronous.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#isValidB: It takes a string and returns a boolean indicating whether it is valid Base64: empty strings pass, lengths not divisible by four fail, and otherwise it must decode without error.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/registries.js#$ZodRe: This class is a registry that associates schemas with metadata, enforces unique identifiers, and supports adding, removing, clearing, and checking entries, with lookups returning metadata merged from parent schemas.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#handleAr: It takes one element's validation result, an accumulated result object, and a position. It adds any issues, tagged with that position, and stores the element's value there, returning nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#isValidB: It takes a string and returns true or false: whether it is valid URL-safe base64, checked by converting it to standard base64 with padding and validating that.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#handleOb: It takes a validation result for one object property, a combined result being built, and the property name; it adds any problems, labeled with that property's path, and stores the property's value, returning nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#handleOp: It takes a property's validation result, an accumulating output object, the property name, and the original input, and merges them, ignoring failures for missing or undefined optional properties; it returns nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#generate: Given an object schema's field definitions, it compiles and returns a specialized validator function that checks each property, prefixes error paths with the field name, handles optional fields, and builds the result object.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#isValidJ: The function takes a token string and an optional expected signing algorithm, and returns true only if the token is structurally a JWT whose header declares an algorithm matching any requested one; it does not verify the signature.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#handleUn: Given validation results from each union option, it returns the final result holding the first successful option's value, or adds an invalid-union issue containing every option's finalized errors.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#parseStr: It takes a property name, escapes it, and returns a generated code snippet that runs that property's schema validator on the matching input value with a fresh issue list.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#mergeVal: Takes two values and recursively deep-merges them, returning the combined result if they're compatible, or a failure with the path where they conflict.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#handleTu: It takes one element's validation outcome, an aggregate tuple result and a position, copies any issues into the aggregate with the position prefixed, stores the value there, and returns nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#handleIn: It takes a validation result and two sub-validation outcomes, collects their issues, and, unless validation aborted, returns the result holding both values deep-merged, throwing if they conflict.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#handleMa: This takes the validation results for one map entry's key and value, records any problems (path-prefixed or wrapped) into an accumulating result, and stores the validated entry; returns nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#handlePi: It takes the result of the first validation stage, a pipeline definition, and a context. It returns that result unchanged if aborted, otherwise the output of running it through the second stage.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#handleSe: It takes a single element's parsing outcome and an aggregate set outcome, copies any validation problems into the aggregate, adds the element's parsed value to its collection, and returns nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#handleRe: It takes an object, makes its contained data immutable with a shallow freeze, and returns that same object with the frozen data in place.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#handleNo: It takes a validation result and its schema instance, adds an invalid-type issue when the value is undefined and no prior issues exist, and returns the same result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#handleDe: It takes a result object and a definition object, fills in the definition's default when the result has no value, and returns the same, possibly modified, result object.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.cjs#handleRe: It takes a refinement check's outcome, a validation payload, the input value and the validator instance; if the check failed, it records a custom issue in the payload, returning nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.js#isValidBa: It takes a string and returns true or false for whether it is valid URL-safe Base64. It does this by checking the allowed characters, converting it to standard Base64 with padding, and validating the result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/to-json-schema.cjs#J: This method takes a validation schema object and recursively converts it into an equivalent JSON Schema fragment, caching results to track reuse and cycles, and returns that fragment.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.js#isValidBa: It takes a string and returns true if it is empty or is properly padded, decodable base64 text, otherwise false.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.js#generateF: It takes an object schema's field definitions and returns a compiled validator that parses each property of an input object, collects path-prefixed errors, handles optional fields, and outputs the parsed result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/schemas.js#isValidJW: It takes a token string and an optional expected signing algorithm, and returns whether the token has three parts with a decodable header declaring an algorithm (matching any expected one).
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/to-json-schema.cjs#p: It takes a validation schema and optional path-tracking information, converts it into an equivalent JSON Schema fragment while caching visited schemas and detecting cycles, and returns that fragment.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/to-json-schema.cjs#i: It takes an object, such as a schema definition, and returns true only if its single property is the key naming a combined "all of" list, otherwise false.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/to-json-schema.cjs#m: It takes a schema entry and returns a reference path for it, plus a definition identifier when needed, pointing to an external registry, a shared definitions file, the root, or local definitions.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/to-json-schema.cjs#f: Given a validation schema and options, it recursively merges any referenced parent's generated JSON Schema into this schema's output, then applies custom overrides; it mutates in place and returns nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/to-json-schema.cjs#e: It takes a key–record pair, copies the record's schema into a separate definition, and empties the original in place, leaving only a reference pointer; it returns nothing and skips schemas that are already references.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/to-json-schema.js#JS: It takes a validation schema object, plus optional path tracking, and recursively converts it into a JSON Schema fragment, caching visited schemas to detect reuse and cycles.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/to-json-schema.cjs#t: It converts either a single validation schema or a registry of identified schemas into JSON Schema, returning one schema, or a keyed collection of schemas plus any shared definitions.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/to-json-schema.cjs#i: It takes a validation schema and recursively walks its nested parts, avoiding cycles, and returns true or false for whether any part applies a data transformation.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/util.cjs#assertEqual: This function takes a single value and returns that same value unchanged, despite its name suggesting it would compare values or check equality.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/util.cjs#assertNotEq: This function takes a single value and returns it unchanged; despite its name, it performs no comparison or check.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/util.cjs#assert@56: This placeholder assertion function accepts a single argument, ignores it entirely, performs no checks or side effects, and returns nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/to-json-schema.cjs#e: This function takes a previously processed validation schema plus options for cycles, reused subschemas and external registries, and produces a JSON Schema with shared, identified or cyclic parts extracted into referenced definitions.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/util.cjs#assertNever: This function accepts a single value it never uses and returns nothing, because it always throws an error, typically marking code paths that should be unreachable.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/to-json-schema.js#pr: It takes a validation schema and optional path context, converts it into an equivalent JSON Schema object while caching visited schemas and detecting cycles, and returns that JSON Schema object.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/to-json-schema.js#to: Converts either a single validation schema or a registry of identified schemas, plus optional settings, into JSON Schema, returning one document or a keyed collection with shared definitions.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/util.cjs#cleanRegex@: It takes a regular expression pattern string and returns it with any leading start-of-string anchor and trailing end-of-string anchor removed.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/util.cjs#getEnumValu: The function takes an enum-like object, which may include reverse mappings from numbers back to names, and returns a list of its genuine member values with those reverse-mapping entries excluded.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/util.cjs#jsonStringi: This function receives a property key and its value during JSON serialization, returning arbitrarily large integers converted to strings and passing every other value through unchanged.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/util.cjs#joinValues@: It takes a list of values and an optional delimiter, which defaults to a vertical bar, converts each value to a string, and returns them joined into one string.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/util.cjs#nullish@85: It takes any single value and returns a boolean that is true only when the value is null or undefined, and false otherwise.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/util.cjs#defineLazy@: It takes an object, a property name, and a value-producing function, and installs a lazily computed property that is cached permanently on first access; it returns nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/util.cjs#getElementA: Given an object and a list of keys, it walks down the nested structure and returns the value found there, the object itself if no path is given, or undefined if any step is missing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/util.cjs#cached@72: It takes a zero-argument function and returns an object whose single property calls that function on first access, then permanently stores and returns the result on later accesses.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/util.cjs#set@112: This setter takes a new value and redefines the target object's property to hold it as a fixed, non-writable, non-enumerable value, replacing the accessor; it returns nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/util.cjs#assignProp@: It takes an object, a property name and a value, and defines that property on the object as writable, enumerable and configurable, bypassing any setters; it returns nothing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/core/util.cjs#get@104: Taking no arguments, this accessor computes a value lazily on first access, stores it on the object under its property name, and returns it, raising an error if one was already stored.

descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#uuid@60: This function takes optional configuration parameters and returns a lightweight schema that validates whether a string is a properly formatted universally unique identifier.

descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#emoji@85: It takes optional configuration settings, such as a custom error message, and returns a schema validator that checks whether a string is a valid emoji.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#url@78: This function takes optional configuration parameters and returns a new schema validator that checks whether a value is a valid URL string, built using the lightweight schema library's core factory.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#uuidv7@71: It takes optional configuration parameters, such as a custom error message, and returns a validation schema that accepts only strings formatted as version 7 UUIDs.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#uuidv6@67: The function takes optional configuration parameters and returns a lightweight validation schema that accepts only strings formatted as version 6 universally unique identifiers.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#nanoid@92: It takes optional configuration settings, such as a custom error message, and returns a lightweight validation schema that checks whether a string is a valid Nano ID.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#cuid2@106: It takes optional configuration parameters and returns a lightweight schema validator that checks whether a string is a valid collision-resistant unique identifier in the second-generation format.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#cuid@99: It takes optional configuration settings and returns a lightweight validation schema that checks whether a string is a properly formatted collision-resistant unique identifier.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#ipv4@134: It takes optional configuration parameters and returns a lightweight schema validator that checks whether a string is a valid IPv4 address.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#xid@120: It takes optional configuration such as custom error messages and returns a validation schema that checks whether a string is a correctly formatted globally unique XID identifier.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#ksuid@127: It takes optional configuration parameters and returns a lightweight validation schema that checks whether a string is a valid K-Sortable Unique Identifier.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#ipv6@141: It takes optional configuration parameters and returns a schema validator that checks whether a string is a valid IPv6 address, built using a lightweight validation library's core factory.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#cidrv4@14: It takes optional configuration parameters and returns a validation schema that checks whether a string is a valid IPv4 address range in CIDR notation.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#ulid@113: This function takes optional configuration parameters and returns a schema validator that checks whether a string is a valid ULID (universally unique lexicographically sortable identifier).
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#number@19: This function takes optional configuration parameters and returns a new number validation schema, built by passing them and the lightweight number schema class to a core factory.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#stringFor: It takes a format name, a validation function or regular expression, and optional settings, and returns a custom string schema that checks strings against that format.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#base64@16: This function takes optional configuration parameters and returns a lightweight validation schema that accepts only strings containing valid base64-encoded data.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#cidrv6@15: This function takes optional configuration parameters and returns a lightweight validation schema that checks whether a string is a valid IPv6 address range in slash-prefix notation.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#base64url: Takes optional configuration parameters and returns a new string schema validator that checks whether a value is a valid URL-safe base64-encoded string.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#jwt@183: It takes optional configuration settings and returns a lightweight validation schema that checks whether a string is a properly formatted JSON Web Token.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#e164@176: This function takes optional configuration options and returns a lightweight schema validator that checks whether a string is a phone number in the standard international telephone format.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#int@205: This function takes optional configuration settings and returns a lightweight validation schema that accepts only integer numbers, built by passing a number-format schema type to a shared core helper.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#float32@2: This function takes optional configuration settings and returns a lightweight validation schema that accepts only numbers fitting within the range of a 32-bit floating-point value.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#uint32@22: It takes optional configuration parameters and returns a number schema that validates values as unsigned 32-bit integers, built with the lightweight validation library's number-format schema type.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#float64@2: This function takes optional configuration settings and returns a lightweight validation schema that accepts only numbers fitting the 64-bit floating-point format, built by delegating to a shared core helper.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#int32@217: It takes optional configuration parameters and returns a lightweight number schema validator restricted to 32-bit signed integers, built by delegating to a shared core helper.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#boolean@2: This function takes optional configuration settings and returns a new lightweight validation schema that accepts only true or false values, built using a shared core factory.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#bigint@23: It takes optional configuration parameters and returns a new validation schema that accepts big integer values, built with the library's lightweight schema type.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#uint64@24: It takes optional configuration settings and returns a validation schema that accepts only big integer values within the unsigned 64-bit range, built from the library's lightweight variant.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#int64@243: This function takes optional configuration parameters and returns a lightweight validation schema that accepts big integer values constrained to the signed 64-bit integer range.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#symbol@25: It takes optional configuration parameters and returns a new validation schema that only accepts JavaScript symbol values, built through a shared core factory using the lightweight schema class.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#_null@269: This factory function takes optional configuration parameters and returns a new schema that validates that a value is exactly null, built with a core helper on a lightweight schema class.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#any@277: This function takes no arguments and returns a new lightweight validation schema that accepts any value, built by passing a minimal schema class to a shared core factory.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#unknown@2: This function takes no arguments and returns a new lightweight validation schema that accepts any value, typed as unknown, built with the library's core schema factory.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#date@306: It takes optional configuration parameters and returns a new schema that validates date values, built by passing those parameters to a core date-schema factory.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#never@291: This function takes optional configuration settings and returns a validation schema that rejects every input, so no value can ever pass it.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#_void@298: This function takes optional configuration parameters and returns a new lightweight validation schema that accepts only undefined values, by delegating to a shared core factory.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#object@33: It takes a mapping of field names to schemas plus optional configuration, and returns a new lightweight object-validation schema whose field definitions are copied lazily on first access.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#_undefine: This function takes optional configuration settings and returns a lightweight validation schema that accepts only JavaScript's "not defined" value, built by passing its schema type to a shared core constructor.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#array@313: It takes a schema describing individual items plus optional configuration, and returns a new lightweight validation schema that accepts lists whose every item matches that item schema.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#extend@37: This function takes an existing validation definition and a set of additional field definitions, and returns a new definition combining both by delegating to a shared helper.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#strictObj: It takes a set of field definitions plus optional configuration and returns an object validation schema that rejects any keys not explicitly defined, with the field definitions lazily copied on first access.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#looseObje: It takes a field-schema definition and optional settings, and returns an object validator that checks the listed fields while accepting and keeping any extra unknown properties.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#merge@374: It takes an existing schema and a set of additional field definitions, and returns a schema extended to include those new or overriding fields alongside the original ones.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#partial@3: This function takes an object schema and an optional selection of keys, and returns a new schema where those fields (or all fields, if none are selected) become optional.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#pick@377: This function takes a validation definition and a selection of keys, then delegates to a utility helper to return a new definition containing only the selected fields.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#catchall@: It takes a schema object and a fallback schema, and returns a copy of the original whose definition is updated to validate any unrecognized keys against that fallback.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#union@397: It takes a list of schema options and optional configuration settings, and returns a new validation schema that accepts values matching any one of those options.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#required@: It takes an object schema and an optional selection of keys, and returns a new schema in which those fields, or all fields if none are selected, are required.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#discrimin: It takes a discriminator key, a list of option schemas and optional settings, and returns a new schema that validates against whichever option matches that key.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#omit@381: This function takes a data structure definition and a selection of keys, passes them to a shared helper, and returns a new definition with the selected fields removed.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#partialRe: It takes a key schema, a value schema, and optional settings, and returns a record schema whose keys are all optional, so not every possible key must be present.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#tuple@431: It takes a list of element schemas, an optional schema for extra trailing elements, and optional settings, and returns a new schema that validates fixed-position arrays.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#set@478: It takes an element schema and optional configuration, and returns a new lightweight validation schema for sets whose members must all match that element schema.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#intersect: It takes two validation schemas and returns a new combined schema that accepts only values satisfying both, recording the two inputs as its left and right parts.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#map@466: It takes schemas for keys and values plus optional settings, and returns a new validation schema describing a map whose entries must match those key and value types.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#_enum@489: It takes a list or mapping of allowed values plus optional settings, and returns a schema that accepts only those values, turning a list into a mapping of each value to itself.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#nativeEnu: It takes an object of named enumeration values plus optional settings and returns a new schema that validates input against those enumeration values.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#literal@5: It takes one or more allowed constant values plus optional configuration and returns a schema that validates input matching exactly one of those values.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#record@44: It takes a key schema, a value schema, and optional settings, and returns a new validation schema for objects whose keys and values match those schemas.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#optional@: It takes a schema and returns a new schema wrapping it that also accepts a missing value, making the original schema optional.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#file@527: It takes optional configuration settings and returns a new schema for validating file objects, built by passing a lightweight file schema type to a shared core factory.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#transform: It takes a callback that converts values and returns a new schema object that applies that conversion to its input during parsing.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#nullable@: It takes an existing schema and returns a new wrapper schema that accepts either values valid for that schema or null.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#_default@: It takes a schema and a fallback value or value-producing function, and returns a wrapped schema that supplies that fallback, computed fresh each time if it's a function.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#nonoption: It takes an inner schema and optional configuration parameters, and returns a new schema wrapping the inner one that rejects undefined values, making it required.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#success@6: It takes an inner schema and returns a new wrapper schema that checks whether parsing with that inner schema succeeds, typically yielding a true or false result.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#prefault@: It takes an inner schema and a fallback value, or a function producing one, and returns a wrapping schema that substitutes that fallback for missing input before validation.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#_catch@61: It takes an inner schema and a fallback value or function, and returns a wrapping schema that yields the fallback whenever validation of the inner schema fails.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#nan@627: This function takes optional configuration parameters and returns a new schema that validates values as Not-a-Number, built by passing them to an internal core factory.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#pipe@634: It takes an input schema and an output schema and returns a new schema that chains them, feeding the first schema's validated result into the second.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#templateL: It takes a sequence of literal pieces and schemas plus optional settings, and returns a lightweight validation schema matching strings shaped like that template.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#readonly@: It takes an existing schema and returns a new wrapper schema that validates with the original but marks the resulting parsed value as immutable and unmodifiable.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#promise@6: This takes a schema describing some value type and returns a new schema that validates promises whose resolved values must match that inner type.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#check@691: The function takes a validation callback and optional settings, and returns a new custom validation check object that runs that callback when data is validated.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#_lazy@669: It takes a function that produces a schema and returns a lazy schema wrapper that calls that function only when needed, which makes recursive or deferred definitions possible.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#custom@70: It takes an optional validation function and optional settings, and returns a custom schema that validates values with that function, or accepts any value when none is given.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#refine@70: It takes a validation predicate and optional configuration settings, and returns a custom schema check that validates data by applying that predicate.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#json@727: It takes no arguments and returns a lazily defined, recursive validation schema that accepts any JSON value: strings, numbers, booleans, null, and arrays or string-keyed objects containing such values.
descriptions.zod-3.25.76/v4/mini/schemas.js#stringboo: This function accepts optional configuration for which text values count as true or false and returns a validation schema that turns matching strings into booleans, built from lightweight schema components.
